update.x-as-note: Auth uses CONFLUENCE_SITE_URL, CONFLUENCE_EMAIL and CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN; discovery needs none. Sandbox: api --transport responder or CONFLUENCE_AS_TRANSPORT=cassette with CONFLUENCE_AS_CASSETTE; wrappers use CONFLUENCE_MOCK_MODE. body-format selects storage or atlas_doc_format. Transport honors Retry-After for 429; exhausted retries exit 6. Errors use JSON stderr: 0 success, 1 other, 2 usage, 3 auth, 4 scope/permission, 5 not found, 6 server/transport, 7 conflict (409, no retry); see as-engine docs/exit-codes.md.
